editorial.blurb: An iconic Chicago dive near Guaranteed Rate Field serving up some of the city's best classic hot dogs and burgers with fresh-cut fries since forever.
editorial.insiderTip: Bring cash only and arrive before White Sox game days—this beloved spot gets packed with stadium crowds, so hit it early for the quickest service.
